about: Caps (every tile of the made Cap garment in every sport: Cap, Club cap, Golf cap, Cricket cap, Cycling cap, Headwear Cap; not the 5 panel cap, its own garment): Tripo model cap-textured.glb (card 95707: a six-panel cap with a curved brim and a top button; shape only, its plain texture not used), placed on the made cap's place and printed through the made cap's own pattern (capprint.js) by viewer/tripo-hat.mjs, so the tile's look, artwork on the front and our marks print as on the made cap.
